knowHow.text: Belonging to the same material family of copolyesters, PCTG filament offers similar ease of printing as PET-G.
higher transparency than standard PET-G (applies to transparent colours)
ease of printing, processing and finishing
A very important advantage of the Premium PCTG filament is its increased impact strength, high dimensional stability and low shrinkage.
high dimensional accuracy of the printed elements
excellent print surface
Dry box not necessary
hydrophobic
Ruby or hardened nozzle not necessary
odourless
The material combines high chemical and thermal resistance with mechanical properties, such as high impact resistance, scratch resistance and excellent optical brilliance.
Excellent transparency
Hardened Nozzle no
It boasts tremendous impact toughness and durability, superior chemical and UV resistance, and even greater clarity than PETG.
Lower moisture absorption rate than PETG
Pro PCTG typically doesn’t require an enclosure, making it an ecellent choice for functional parts, prototypes, or any project needing robust, dependable filament performance.
3D printing end-use parts.
It is suitable for (food) packaging, electronic housings and even biomedical applications.
Making tooling and manufacturing aids.
This PCTG filament 3D prints as easy as PETG.
But, with a superior clarity and impact resistance.
Its impact resistance is comparable to Tough PLA.
Precise parts that are durable, tough, and have a good resistance to chemicals.
AthenaX is a water-resistant polymer, which makes it a very versatile material.
High transparency / clarity.
AthenaX enables you to 3D print parts with high dimensional accuracy.
Athena's X-factor ensures low shrinkage plus increased bed- and layer adhesion.
PCTG is moderately hygroscopic and therefore it is recommended to pre-dry the filament at 75°C for approximately 24 hours before usage for optimal results.
For optimal print results we recommend to print AthenaX filament from a drying box to avoid that the material can accumulate humidity from the environment.
PCTG combines high chemical resistance with excellent layer adhesion and high impact strength.
Amorphous structure giving it a low, near isotropic shrinkage
PCTG prints are significantly more resistant to impacts and mechanical stress.
Temperature & chemical resistant PCTG filament with high optical clarity
Fiberlogy PCTG is BPA-free , fully recyclable , and, in its Pure TR version, approved for food contact* , which further expands its range of applications.

Food-contact claim confined to Pure TR version; underlying approval and final printed article/migration compliance not retrieved. No all-colour or printed-part certification.

knowHow.text: PCTG offers good resistance to UV, moisture, and heat, making it generally suitable for outdoor use. However, prolonged, permanent outdoor exposure can still cause gradual fading or embrittlement over time.

polymer.basis: Classification and typical values from polymer handbooks and resin data sheets, as compiled for the estimate model (docs/audits/2026-09-15-filtering-estimates-data/physics/). SK chemicals' safety data sheet for SKYGREEN JN200 (R-SKCHEMICALS-INTAKE-20261019-908c225fa945), which calls its SKYGREEN J resins PCTG, prints a specific gravity of 1.23 (ASTM D792), p. 2. It prints no water absorption.
